metadata.description: Plugin marketplace for the expectation-fit Claude Code plugin

plugins.name: expectation-fit
plugins.description: Enforce expectation fit: software that behaves the way a reasonable developer or user expects. Five lenses (predictability, convention, simplicity, experience, architecture) for planning, plan validation, code review, and codebase audit, with project-level .expectation-fit config and architecture packs for Rails, Python, Laravel, Express, Phoenix, and React.
